title: We're so sorry
condolence: We're so sorry for what you're going through. The time you spent caring for your parent mattered, and so did you. Your subscription has ended and your data is gone from our servers. Nothing more is needed from you.
resourcesIntro: If it helps to talk with someone, these services are free.

resources.name: Alzheimer's Association 24/7 Helpline
resources.description: Free support from trained staff, day or night, including for families after a loss or a move.

resources.name: 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline
resources.description: Call or text 988, any time, if the weight feels too heavy.

resources.name: Hospice Foundation of America: grief support
resources.description: Articles and guidance for people who are grieving.
